us.note: RE-CONFIRMED 16 NOV 2026 at the US Embassy Nairobi advisory page (ke.usembassy.gov, posted 20 Oct, read at primary): Level 3, Level 4 areas unchanged. travel.state.gov still serves a stale 28 Jul Level 2 page; do not cite it. RAISED FROM LEVEL 2 TO LEVEL 3 (RECONSIDER TRAVEL) ON 19 OCT 2026, mainly on Ebola (Bundibugyo) health risk plus crime, kidnapping, terrorism, unrest and traffic safety (travel.state.gov rendered page read 20 Oct; page footer still says last updated 30 July, which conflicts; Kenyans.co.ke 20 Oct 07:30 EAT). Level 4 areas UNCHANGED from the 28 July re-issue. Kenya had 8 confirmed Ebola cases at 19 Oct. Electronic Traveler Health Surveillance Form required for travellers from DRC, South Sudan, Uganda. PRIOR TEXT: Terrorism, crime, kidnapping, unrest, health and 'Other'. Country level was 2. Re-issued 28 July 2026 (rendered page carries 'Date issued: July 28, 2026', verified 12 Aug 2026) — the 'Other (O)' indicator was added and the Nairobi neighbourhoods of EASTLEIGH and KIBERA are now LEVEL 4 DO NOT TRAVEL (crime, kidnapping), corrected from our earlier Level 3 reading. Also Level 4: Garissa, Wajir, Mandera, Lamu, Tana River (except Tsavo NP), Kilifi north of the C103 and coastal areas north of Malindi; West Pokot and western Turkana; Marsabit and Turkana within 50km of Ethiopia. Nairobi hotel corridors (Westlands, Upper Hill, Gigiri, CBD, Karen), Diani and Watamu are not in any Level 4 area.

uk.note: RE-READ 23 NOV 2026 at gov.uk: still dated 6 Nov ('still current at' 23 Nov); no new area. GERMANY CORRECTED 23 NOV 2026: Auswärtiges Amt Kenya page (Teilreisewarnung) is Stand 22 Nov 2026, VALID SINCE 19 NOV 2026 — our 19 Nov entry saying it was unchanged since 19 Oct was wrong. Warns against travel (Reisewarnung) to Mandera, Wajir, Garissa and Lamu counties except Lamu and Manda islands; STRONGLY ADVISES AGAINST (dringend abgeraten) Baringo, West Pokot and Turkana in the North Rift, northern Tana River County (including the A3) and the Moyale area of Marsabit County; advises against the Ethiopian border area; special caution in Elgeyo Marakwet, Samburu and the Laikipia–Meru–Isiolo tri-county area. Notes fighting on the Ethiopian side of Moyale since end-October. Ebola: last patient discharged 11 Nov; Kenya Ebola-free from 23 Dec 2026 if no new case (auswaertiges-amt.de, read at primary 23 Nov). The UK warns against none of Baringo. GERMANY Stand 19 Nov 2026, unchanged since 19 Oct. RE-READ 16 NOV 2026 at the gov.uk content API: still dated 6 Nov, no newer change. OTHER GOVERNMENTS, read 16 Nov at primary: CANADA updated 2 Nov 2026, high degree of caution unchanged; its latest change REMOVED the dengue travel health notice. Canada advises against all travel to Mandera, Wajir, Garissa and Lamu counties (except Lamu and Manda islands), Turkana and Marsabit within 110km of South Sudan and Ethiopia, within 50km of the Tana River coast and the Kilifi coast north of Malindi; avoid non-essential travel to Kibera. Country level and all other areas unchanged; no core safari, Nairobi or coast area affected. PREVIOUS: RE-DATED 28 OCT 2026 (read at the gov.uk content API, 5 Nov): updated Ebola screening information and an automated WhatsApp health line on Entry requirements; LEVEL AND AREAS UNCHANGED. Advises against ALL travel to Mandera County; Tarbaj and Wajir East (except Wajir Town) and areas of Wajir within 60km of Somalia; Garissa County except Garissa Town, Lagdera and parts of Balambala; Lamu County except Lamu and Manda islands. All-but-essential: Garissa Town; Tana River County north of the river to Saka; within 15km of the coast between the Tana and Galana rivers. EARLIER: Against travel to the Kenya–Somalia border and parts of Lamu/north coast; core safari & coast areas unaffected. HEALTH LAYER (separate from the advisory): three G7 governments carried a dengue notice on Kenya naming the COAST (CANADA REMOVED ITS NOTICE ON 2 NOV 2026) — US Embassy Nairobi health alert 3 Aug 2026 (coast, Wajir, Garissa); Germany 3 Aug 2026; CANADA added Kenya to Travel Health Notice 517 on 8 Sep 2026. Canada’s notice is Level 1 — practise health precautions — and did NOT change any country risk level. Kenya MoH: 1,678 dengue cases and 5 suspected deaths in Garissa and Wajir as at 26 Aug 2026 (1,276 in Dadaab), PHEOC activated; separately Mombasa recorded 3,989 cases Jan–May 2026 (Health CS Aden Duale via The Standard). The UK has NOT added a dengue line to its Kenya health page as at 9 Sep 2026. EBOLA: FCDO Kenya page re-dated 7 Oct 2026 with Ebola detection and Kenyan response information after the first imported case (3 Oct arrival, died in Nairobi); no change to level or regional exceptions. RE-DATED 16 OCT 2026: new Ebola screening information on Entry requirements; level and exceptions unchanged (read directly 20 Oct). CANADA KENYA updated 15 Oct 2026 (eTA health insurance note); risk level high degree of caution unchanged.

us.note: RE-CONFIRMED 16 NOV 2026: Level 4, last reissued 4 Jun 2026 (US Embassy Kampala advisory page, read at primary). State re-listed Uganda among Level 4 countries on 9 Nov without reissuing the advisory (Watchdog Uganda, 10 Nov; UBC, 12 Nov, citing the Minister of State in Parliament on 11 Nov). TITLE 42 ORDER RENEWED: signed 9 Nov, effective 5pm 10 Nov, expires 4:59pm EST Thu 10 Dec 2026, still covering DRC, Uganda and South Sudan; Kenya not covered (cdc.gov November order, read at primary; FR Doc 2026-23114, published 13 Nov). The line below saying the order runs to 10 Nov is superseded. Do not travel — VERIFIED against travel.state.gov 3 Sep 2026. Date issued 4 June 2026; indicators Crime, Health, Terrorism, Unrest. Advisory history states Uganda was raised from Level 3 to Level 4 on 17 May 2026 'due to the Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease outbreak in Ituri Province in the DRC'. The page still describes Kampala mass-gathering restrictions, 21-day quarantine for DRC arrivals and the DRC border closure. NOT UPDATED since 4 June — 91 days — despite Uganda MoH declaring the outbreak over on 28 Jul 2026 and WHO declaring the end on 27 Aug 2026. State's own text links to a CDC travel health notice filed under a Level 2 path. Divergence with the UK (Level 1) is now two full levels. NOT RE-VERIFIED 5 NOV 2026: travel.state.gov could not be read. US ENTRY ORDERS (verified 5 Nov): the CDC Title 42 order on travellers recently in the DRC, Uganda or South Sudan runs 11 Oct to 10 Nov 2026 unless renewed (91 FR 65556, published 15 Oct; AILA and Erickson Immigration Group). SEPARATELY, from 11:59pm EST 3 Nov to 18 Dec 2026, EVERY person boarding a US-bound flight from any country must sign an attestation of no DRC presence in the previous 21 days (CDC amended order signed 28 Oct, FR Doc 2026-22211, read at primary). DOT (28 Oct, primary): airlines may refuse boarding to foreign nationals and LPRs who were in Uganda in the prior 21 days, and must route US citizens from Uganda through designated airports.

CANADA (travel.gc.ca, updated 9 Sep 2026, read 16 Nov): normal security precautions, with a high degree of caution in parts of Rubavu (including Gisenyi), Rusizi within 10km of the DRC, and the Volcanoes NP border section. EARLIER: CORRECTED 8 Sep 2026 — the FCDO advice-against area is PARTS OF RUSIZI DISTRICT ONLY: the parts within 10km of the DRC border, including the Rwandan islands in Lake Kivu and Kamembe Airport. RUBAVU IS NOT NAMED. We carried 'Rubavu, Rusizi' and were overstating it — Gisenyi/Rubavu on Lake Kivu carries no advice against travel, and Kigali, Musanze/Volcanoes, Nyungwe and Akagera are all outside the advice-against area. Verified by reading gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/rwanda/entry-requirements directly on 8 Sep 2026; the page's own public-updated-at is 4 Sep 2026 10:15 BST. ENTRY RULE, separate from the advisory: Rwanda denies entry to any foreign national who has travelled to or transited through the DRC in the 30 days before travel, and runs enhanced screening at Kigali International Airport and DRC land crossings (Rwanda MoH notice, 22 May 2026; FCDO links to RBC for it). Commonwealth citizens get a free 30-day visa on arrival.
